title: Chats should export as Markdown, readable HTML, or JSONL
body: Add conversation export formats for Markdown, Folio-styled standalone HTML, and JSON Lines. Support optional tool calls and reasoning/thoughts, preserve code blocks and inline images, and expose the options through the launcher.
interface: session export supports format=markdown/html/jsonl and optional tools/thoughts flags.
why: Export and data-portability work is a realistic multi-file backend plus launcher feature.
